description:
## v1.1.0

Adds a media notification fix and groups the patches by category in Morphe Manager.

- Song info in media notification (new, Player): shows the song title and its album art in the media notification and the system media player, instead of the station name with no picture.
- Patches are now grouped as Player, Premium and Privacy.
- Built against Morphe patcher 2.0.0.
